THIS MEMORANDUM OF LEASE (the “Memorandum") is entered into as of May 1, 2024 (the “Effective Date"), by and between JFK HOTEL PARTNERS LLC ("Landlord"), a New York limited liability company, having an office at c/o McSam Hotel Group LLC at 420 Great Neck Road, Great Neck, New York 11021, and JFK QB VILLAGE PARKING LLC ("Tenant"), a New York limited liability company, having an office at c/o McSam Hotel Group LLC at 420 Great Neck Road, Great Neck, New York 11021. 1. Premises. Landlord owns the parcel o real property commonly known as n/a 135th Avenue, Jamaica, Queens, New York, more particularly described in Exhibit A attached hereto (the"Premises").  2. Lease. Landlord entered into a Lease of the Premises with Tenant, dated as of May 1, 2024 (the “Lease") and demised the Premises to Tenant, as described in the Lease. 3. Term. The Term of the Lease will begin on the “Commencement Date” and will expire on April 30, 2073, unless the Lease is terminated earlier as provided therein. 4. Right of Refusal. If Landlord elects to sell the fee title to the Premises, on an “arm's length" basis, Tenant will have a period of fifteen (15) Business Days to notify Landlord, in writing, of its election to acquire the Premises upon the exact terms and conditions set forth in a notice of said election and pursuant to certain other terms and conditions as are set forth in the Lease.  5. No Effect on Lease. This Memorandum is prepared, signed, and acknowledged for recording purposes under New York law. This Memorandum does not modify, increase, decrease, or in any other way affect the rights, duties, and obligations of Landlord and Tenant under the Lease. Landlord and Tenant each has rights, duties, and obligations (and conditions to its rights) under the Lease but not stated in this Memorandum.If the Lease and this Memorandum conflict, the Lease governs. 6.Successors and Assigns. The Lease and this Memorandum will bind and benefit the parties and their successors and permitted assigns. The foregoing will not affect any rights of assignment or other transfer in the Lease or any restrictions on assignment or other transfer in the Lease.  7. Termination. This Memorandum will automatically terminate and be of no force or effect upon any termination of theLease. 8.Further Assurances. Each party will execute, acknowledge (where necessary), and deliver such further documents, and perform such further acts, as may be reasonably necessary to achieve the intent of the parties as expressed in the Lease and this Memorandum. If the Lease terminates, then Tenant will execute, acknowledge (where necessary),and deliver such documents as Landlord may reasonably require or as any title insurance, abstract company, or institutional lender may require to remove this Memorandum of record. 9. Counterparts. This Memorandum may be executed in counterparts. PXH/#1810835v1/0082320-083209
